Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Zimbabwean players take the field following the two umpires. Skipper Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan will open the innings for Pakistan. Blessing Muzarabani will begin with the ball first up. Here we go...

Right. Just 119 is what Pakistan need. Looking at their batting unit, this does not look like a big ask for them. However, if Zimbabwe can strike a couple of early blows, we can be in for an exciting game. Join us for the chase in a short while.

Danish Aziz is caught for a little chat. He says that it is spinning more than the last game. Adds they tried to bowl wicket-to-wicket and it worked. Aziz says this a good opportunity for everyone especially for the youngsters against Zimbabwe.

Pakistan were tight from the start. They did not offer any freebies and were sharp in the field as well. All the bowlers who bowled got at least one wicket. Debutant Arshad was very good in his 4-over spell. Hasnain got two wickets while Danish Aziz playing his 2nd T20I too managed to get two wickets but he was the only one who was taken for a few runs.

Asked to bat first, Zimbabwe just never got going. Taylor who returned in the side fell in the 5th over for just 5 while his partner Tinashe hanged around but he failed to find the fence consistently. Their batters got in but fell trying to up the ante. Tinashe too got out for 34 off 40 balls. Towards the end, Chakabva and Jongew played a few shots and managed to take Zimbabwe close to 120.

Just 4 runs from the last 2 overs and it completes the sorry batting show from Zimbabwe. None of their batters could manage to play big shots in these 20 overs and they have stopped for a very low score of 118 runs. Top work from the Pakistani bowlers though as they kept things tight and regular wickets helped them.
Yorker to finish the innings! It is outside off, Muzrabani looks to get bat on ball but misses. Just 2 off the final over. 4 off the final 2. ZIMBABWE FINISH WITH 118/9!
Length ball on middle and leg. It is bowled at pace. Ngarava takes his eyes off the ball but gets enoug wood on it to send it to the leg side for one.
Full on middle, Muzrabani gets bat on  ball straight down the ground and gets a single.
Richard Ngarava is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Hasnain gets his second of the game. Hasnain bangs it short outside off. Jongwe clears his front leg but adjusts and looks to slap it over cover-point. He hits it high in the air to the left of Fakhar in the deep. He makes no mistake and takes the catch.
Play and a miss! Good length ball outside off, Jongwe looks to ramp but misses.
Blessing Muzarabani is in now.

OUT! RUN OUT! Very unlucky way to be dismissed but Masakadza has to depart. Slower ball bowled into the surface. Jongwe punches it uppishly to the right of Hasnain. He stretches and gets his right hand to it. He fails to hold onto it but the ball hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. Masakadza is too far out of his crease and has to walk back.
Yorker to finish the over. It is on leg, Masakadza des well to get bat on ball.
Wellington Masakadza is in at 9.

OUT! LBW! Rauf gets his first as well. Yorker, a peach of a yorker. It is pacy and right in the hole. Chakabva clears his front leg to hit it on the leg side. He misses and gets hit on the boot. The Pakistan players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. No reviews in this series so the umpire's decision is indeed the final decision.
Now a full pace delivery on a length. Jongwe punches it to the right of the bowler. Rauf gets his hand to it. Takes the pace off the ball. Just one.
Another off pace delivery! This is fuller but outside off again. Jongwe clears his front leg and looks to smack it on the leg side but misses.
Slower ball! It is outside off, outfoxes Jongwe as he comes down the track and misses his swing.
Length ball outside off. Chakabva punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Haris Rauf to bowl the penultimate over of the innings.
SIX! Wonderful shot from Jongwe! He ramps the full ball around off and ramps over fine leg for a biggie.
Length ball outside off, Luke Jongwe swings but misses.
Who is the new man in? Luke Jongwe it is.

OUT! BOWLED! Right on the money and Hasnain gets his first. A pacy yorker on leg pole. Musakanda clears his front leg and swings his bat through the on side. He misses and the leg stump goes for a toss.
Another short ball. Chakabva mistimes his pull but gets it in the gap. Another single.
Short ball around off, Musakanda pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
On the pads, Chakabva looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pad and goes to the leg side. They take a leg bye.
Who will bowl the 18th over?
Couple to end the over. A very good over for Zimbabwe. Shorter on off, Tarisai Musakanda pulls it away from deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Flatter on middle, Musakanda knocks it away and in front of long on for brace.
FOUR! Shorter on off, Musakanda joins the party as he clears his front leg and slams it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shirter on off, Tarisai Musakanda punches it away from long off for two.
Aziz pulls his length back and bowls it around off. Cjhakbva sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! SMOKED! Floated on middle and off. Chakbva gets under it and slg sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.

Fruitful debut for Arshad Iqbal. He finishes with 1/16 from his 4 overs. The last ball is on a length on off, Chakbva glances it to the left of fine leg. He loks for two but Asif Ali gets to the ball quickly and denies them the second.
Play and a miss! Length delivery outside off, Chakabva looks to ramp it over the bowler's head but misses.
Slightly shorter, Musakanda pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Length ball on off, Musakanda punches it back to the bowler.
Appeal but turned down. Good length delivery on middle, Musakanda looks to flick but misses. There is an appeal but the umpire is not keen as he feels that is going over the stumps.
Good length and around middle, Chakabva flicks it to fine leg for one.
Pace back on! Arshad Iqbal to bowl out.
Single on the last ball. Full and around off, pushed through covers for one. 85 for 5 after 15 overs.
Full and on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for one by Tarisai.
The new man in is Tarisai Musakanda!

OUT! TIMBER! Danish has another one. Another player falls trying to play reverse sweep. A flat ball, it is around off, Madhevere looks to play the reverse sweep but he fails to connect. The ball goes behind to disturb the castle. Half the side back in the hut for Zimbabwe.
Flat and around middle, punched down to long on for a run.
Loopy and on middle, Wesley comes down the track and hits it to long on for one.
Tossed up and outside off, Madhevere lofts it wide of long off and takes two.
Full and on middle, swept down to deep mid-wicket for one. 8 runs and a wicket off the over.
Short and around middle, Madhevere pulls it wide of Hafeez at fine leg who runs to his left and makes a tumbling stop. Two taken.
Shrot and down the leg side. Pulled to deep square leg for one.
Two more! Full and on middle, Chakabva flicks it through mid-wicket and scampers back for two.
Flat and around off, Chakabva comes down the track and tucks it towards mid on. They go for the second. The bowler goes after the ball. He throws at the non-striker's end but they make it in easily.
Who will walk out to bat now? Regis Chakabva is the new man in.
OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust. Tossed up and around off, Burl looks to play the reverse sweep but ends up getting it off the gloves. The ball loops behind and the keeper makes no mistake.
Flat and outside off, poked towards short third man for a single. 6 off the over and a wicket too.
In the air... safe! Tossed up and around off and middle, Ryan slogs it uppishly. It goes wide of dee mid-wicket. Two taken.
Full and on middle, flicked to short fine leg for nothing.
Ryan Burl walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT! The change works for Pakistan. First T20I wicket for Danish. Kamunhukamwe's struggle in the middle is over now. Smart from Danish. He bangs it short and follows the batsman too. Kamunhukamwe is cramped for room as he looks to cut. Ends up giving a simple chance to the Pakistani skipper. Azam makes no mistake.
Short and wide, it is cut wide of deep cover for two.
Tossed up and outside off, hit uppishly down to long off for one.
Change in bowling. Danish Aziz is on!

FOUR BYES! Lucky runs but Zimbabwe will take it. Looped up and around off, Tinashe goes for the reverse sweep again. Fails to connect but the ball goes between his legs and it also beats the keeper. The ball races away to the third man fence.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Tossed up and outside off, Kamunhukamwe plays the reverse sweep and hits it over short third man for a boundary.
On middle, this one is swept to fine leg for one.
Loopy ball outside off, Madhevere looks to sweep but ends up getting an inside edge.
The googly! It is tossed up outside off, Madhevere looks to drive but misses.
Excellent running! Shortish and around middle, Wesley  flicks it through mid-wicket. The call is for two straightaway. They make it easily in the end.
Shortish and around off, Madhevere pulls this one down the ground. The mid off runs to his right to stop. A single taken. End of a successful over from the debutant.
FOUR! Welcome boundary. Short and wide outside off, Madhevere slams it over backward pointand finds the fence.
Good length and around middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and wide outside off, Madhevere drives it down to deep cover for one to open his account.
Good length and around off, pushed on the off side.
Who will walk out to bat? It will be Wesley Madhevere!

OUT! TAKEN! Lovely catch and Iqbal gets his first in international cricket. A fullish ball around off, Marumani looks to slog it on the leg side but the ball takes the inside edge and goes to the right of the keeper. Rizwan behind the wickets dives that side and takes a superb catch. The bowler appeals and the finger is raised.
FOUR! Good way to end the over. Flighted around off, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe sweeps it away from deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full toss on middle and leg. Murumani sweeps it to deep backward square leg for one.
Flighted slower outside off. Murumani swings across the line but misses again.
Flighted outside off. Tinashe Kamunhukamwe drags his sweep from outside off to backward square leg for one.
Leg break this time. It is on middle and short in length. Murumani pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.

NOT OUT! Very well down from Murumani! Another wrong 'un and once again Murumani has failed to pick it up. He runs down the track and swings across the line. He misses it. The ball bounces a bit extra. Rizwan gathers the ball and dislodges the bails. Murumani's momentum though sees him get his bat back in.
Stumping appeal taken upstairs. Looks like Tadiwanashe has got his bat down just in time.
Length delivery on the body. Tinashe Kamunhukamwe looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the body
On off, kept out.
Around off, Marumani runs it down to third man for a run.
Length ball on middle and leg. Marumani taps it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Overcooked bouncer from Rauf. Marumani ducks under it.
FOUR! Good shot! Slightly behind length outside off. Marumani flat-bats it through mid off for a boundary.
Length ball around off, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe runs it down to third man for one.
Rauf is back.
Googly to end the over. It is outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani does not pick it up. He looks to slog but misses.

DROPPED! A slightly tough chance but a chance nevertheless. It is the debutant Arshad Iqbal who has put that down. Flatter on middle and off. Tinashe Kamunhukamwe looks to reverse sweep it. He hits it uppishly to the left of the man at point. Arshad Iqbal there gets his hand to it but the ball does not stick in. Single taken.
Short outside off, Marumani pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker outside off. Marumani swings across the line but misses.
Flighted on off, Marumani comes down the track and slices it over the bowler's jhead. Luckily it falls away from long on. Two taken.
Floated on middle, Marumani sweeps it away from fine leg for a brace.
Time for spin! Kamunhukamwe to bowl now.
Marumani is off the mark in T20Is! Back of a length delivery around off, Marumani dabs it third man and keeps the strike.
Fullish ball outside off, Tinashe runs it down to third man for one.
Good length ball on middle and off. Kamunhukamwe looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

The physio will walk out now! The Pakistani players check with Tinashe. The two umpires too show some concern. Kamunhukamwe is looking fine though. The mendatory concussion test will take place. He looks ready to continue. Yes. He is ready again.

OUCH! That has hit him flush on the helmet and the outer protection of the helmet is on the floor. Bouncer! It is around the body, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe lunges forward but then looks to adjust and pull it but misses. The ball hits him flush on the helmet and the Pakistan players have a quick check on him;. Thankfully, Kamunhukanmwe is fine.
Fullish on off, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe pushes it to cover.
Length delivery on middle. Tinashe Kamunhukamwe blocks it.
Arshad Iqbal is back on. 1-0-4-0 from his first over.
WIDE! Banged short on the leg stump line. Left alone. Just 2 off the last over of the Powerplay. 25 for 1 at the end of 6.
Length ball around off, pushed to mid off.
Back of a length and outside off, poked to third man for one.

Appeal for LBW but turned down! A length ball on middle, Tadiwanashe looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pad. The ball rolls on the off side and they sneak a leg bye. An appeal from the bowler but turned down.
Fuller and around off, played back to the bowler.
Good length ball, angled away. Marumani lets it go to the keeeper.
Change in bowling. Haris Rauf is on now to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
Good length and outside off, punched to the man at cover. Successful over from Faheem.
FOUR! SHOT! Lovely shot! Faheem overpitches this one and bowls it on the pads, Tinashe flicks it nicely and finds the fence at deep mid-wicket.
Who will walk out at number 3? Tadiwanashe Marumani!

OUT! TAKEN! Here's the first wicket. Ashraf gets it. A short ball, outside off, Taylor looks to pull but ends up getting a top edge. The ball goes high in the air towards cover. Hafeez settles under it and takes it easily. Not a happy return in the team for Taylor then.
Shrot ball on the pads, Taylor looks to help it over the short fine leg region but misses.
Quick single! A slower short ball, Tinashe once again tries pull. Manages to somehow get it to short fine leg. Taylor calls for a run.
Another mistimed pull. Back of a length ball around off, Tinashe looks to pull but cannot middle it. It goes only to the man at mid-wicket.
Change in bowling. Faheem Ashraf comes back for his second over from the other end.
A single of the ball. Shortish and around off, Tinashe tucks it to the on side and keeps the strike for the next over.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Kamunhukamwe misses to connect the cut shot. Just 3 off the over so far. Can the debutant finish the over well?

Uppish but wide! A back of a length ball, Tinashe cannot pull it off the middle of the blade. The ball goes uppishly but it is wide of mid-wicket. The mid on fielder chases it and keeps it down to two.
Hit hard but straight to mid off. Full and wide outside off. Tinashe nails the drive but finds mid off.
Fullish and outside off, Tinashe looks to drive but the ball takes the inner half and goes to the left of mid-wicket. The fielder dives that side and makes a good stop.
Good length and around middle, Taylor tucks it towards square leg and takes one.
Change in bowling! Arshad Iqbal is into the attack for the first time in T20Is.
A single to end! Good length and outsie off, Taylor looks to cut but the ball takes a thick outside edge and goes to third man.
Banged short again, Tinashe goes for the pull. He is a bit late in the shot and ends up mistiming it to deep mid-wicket. A single. Just 4 off the over so far.
Nicely bowled! Tinashe makes room and Hasnain follows the batsman with a back of a length ball. Tinashe looks to keep it out but misses to get hit on the body.
Banged short and on middle, Tinashe looks to pull but makes no connection.

Excellent stop near the fence. That was a boundary as soon as it left the ball but Rauf made a terrific stop. Short ball outside off, Tinashe slams it through backward point. He hits it hard and the ball is racing to the fence but Rauf from third man runs to his right, dives full length and saves two.
And again! Taylir is happy to get off the mark. Another short ball, he once again stays back and pushes it through point for one.
Back of a length and around off, Taylor once again taps it towards backward point and takes a run. 5 off the 2nd over.
Shrot and angled in, it is clipped to deep square leg for one.
A fullish ball around off, Tinashe lifts it over mid on. It wasn't off the middle but it goes over mid on. Two taken.
Another short of a length ball, played to mid on once again.
Back of a length and on middle, pushed to mid on.
Taylor is up and running first ball. A good length ball, it is outside off, poked towards point for a quick single.
Who will bowl from the other end? It will be Faheem Ashraf!

Confusion but safe in the end. Full and outside off, it is pushed towards point. Tinashe wants the single but Taylor sends him back. The fielder there has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Direct hit would've been end of Tinashe. Just 4 off the over.
Play and a miss! Wide outside off, Kamunhukamwe looks to cut but misses.
FOUR! SHOT! Terrific shot to get things moving. A fullish ball outside off, Kamunhukamwe pucnhes the drive on the up and creams it through the covers for a boundary.
Beaten this time! A length ball, this one is just outside off, Tinashe pokes at it off the back foot but the ball seams away to beat his bat.
Good length ball, around middle, it is worked on the leg side for nothing.
Hasnain is on the money straightaway! Back of a length ball around off and middle, Kamunhukamwe blocks on the leg side.

Both the umpires stride out in the middle and the Pakistani players follow them. Tinashe Kamunhukamwe and Brendan Taylor will open the batting for Zimbabwe. Mohammad Hasnain with the ball first up. Here we go...

Zimbabwe skipper, Brendan Taylor, says that it is good to be back. Adds that it is a very important game for them and hopes the side has learned. Taylor says the bowlers were bang on target in the last game but admits the fielding was sloppy. Informs he is back and Musakanda comes in for Ervine who is struggling with a calf injury.

Pakistan skipper, Babar Azam, starts by saying that they have worked on their mistakes from the first game. Informs that Asif Ali has replaced Haider Ali and Arshad Iqbal is making his debut and he replaces Nawaz. Tells that their middle order struggled so they have added another batsman to fill that gap. Wants to restrict them to a decent total.

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo is inspecting the pitch. Tino says that the sun is shining and there is a breeze as well. Informs that this is the same wicket that was used in the first game. Tino feels there is no grass on the surface and it has dried up from the first game. He adds that the seamers will get a good bounce and carry. Also adds that spinners too will get more purchase than what they got in the first T20I.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Tinashe Kamunhukamwe, Wesley Madhevere, Tadiwanashe Marumani, Tarisai Musakanda (In for) Craig Ervine, Brendan Taylor (C) (In for Sean Williams), Ryan Burl, Regis Chakabva (WK), Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Hafeez, Asif Ali (In for Haider Ali), Danish Aziz, Faheem Ashraf, Arshad Iqbal (In for Mohammad Nawaz), Usman Qadir, Mohammad Hasnain, Haris Rauf.
TOSS - Both the captains are out in the middle for the flip of the coin. Up it goes and it lands in favor of Babar Azam. Pakistan will BOWL FIRST.

Hello and welcome to the second T20I between Zimbabwe and Pakistan. The hosts put up a strong fight but came short in the first T20I. Sean Williams will hope his side put on an improved show especially in the field. Pakistan, on the other hand, got off to a winnings start but their batting barring Rizwan was dodgy. Babar will hope his batters put on a better collective display and seal the T20I series with one game to go. Will Pakistan do what is expected of them or will Zimbabwe spring a surprise and get one over the Asian side? Stay tuned for toss and further updates.
